SELECT e.*, d.name as doctor_name FROM exam e LEFT JOIN doctor d ON e.doctor_id = d.id WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND d.deleted = 0
AND e.exam_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND e.patient_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{patientName}, '%')
AND e.status = #{status}
ORDER BY e.create_time DESC
